label: current-memory-workflows
less_selective_baseline: same current SDK: bounded context, every fixture source file, then all active curated records
measurement_policy: Fixed illustrative engineering fixtures and exact answer/code witnesses; no model calls or autonomous engineering task-success claim.
Fresh SDK objects on every workflow and repetition, closed initializer, initialized warm graph/parser files; OS/interpreter caches may be warm.
Two complete-answer workflows alternate order by repetition; restarted direct-ID memory reuse has a narrower declared witness target.
Detail reads use a fixed page limit, never a stopping choice based on gold answer text. References are discovered from the returned overview.
Source and memory metrics count actual Python Path.open/read results under the fixture. Git/subprocess/kernel reads are excluded; returned UTF-8 bytes are not physical disk bytes.
Discovery scans canonical record bodies locally. Its smaller response is not a claim of fewer memory-file reads.
Memory provenance freshness can hash named source files. Explicit symbol SDK calls each refresh the graph and can re-read the source inventory.
Response caps apply individually to serialized bounded API responses; full rediscovery returns uncapped file/full-memory payloads by definition.
Latency includes read instrumentation and local SDK work. Tokens, model costs and live task success are unavailable, not estimated from characters.
